overview.text: This report details the financial status of the CarMax 2024-1 asset-backed securities trust as of the end of the collection period. The pool balance, representing the total value of the underlying auto loan receivables, stood at 462,790,058.45 (F1). During this period, the trust collected 23,354,676.73 in principal (F2) and recorded 2,266,864.80 in defaulted receivables (F3). The total number of outstanding receivables was 35,458 (F4).

The Class A-3 notes, which are the primary debt instruments sold to investors, had a balance of 235,253,487.77 at the end of the period, down from 260,875,029.30 at the beginning (F5). The pool factor, a metric indicating the remaining principal balance relative to the original pool size, decreased from 0.5214164 to 0.4702060 (F6). The overcollateralization amount, which is the difference between the pool balance and the note balance, was 15,656,570.68 (F7). The weighted average coupon for the notes was 11.54% (F8), and the 30-day average SOFR rate for the accrual period ending 8/16/2026 was 3.62539% (F9).

highlights.text: The trust generated 29,108,512.47 in available collections (F10), which covered the required payment amount of 12,372,263.31 (F12). This resulted in 1,079,678.48 in excess collections, which were deposited into the Certificate Payment Account for distribution to certificateholders (F13, F17).

The servicer fee for the month was 407,009.67 (F11, F21). The total deposits to the Note Payment Account were 27,621,824.32, which matched the total withdrawals from the same account (F15, F16). The Class A-3 principal distribution for the period was 25,621,541.53 (F14).

The reserve account, which acts as a buffer against losses, had an ending balance of 3,914,142.67 (F19). The required reserve account amount is set at 0.15% (F18). A payment of 11,701.56 was made to the Depositor from the reserve account (F20).

Delinquency metrics show 1,815 past due loans with a principal balance of 34,093,563.68 (F22). This represents 7.3670% of the end-of-period pool balance (F23). The report confirms that no Delinquency Trigger Event has occurred (F24).

risks.text: The trust recorded 2,266,864.80 in defaulted receivables during the period (F3). Net losses for the period were 1,321,135.89 (F25), and cumulative net losses reached 42,271,573.62 (F26).
A portion of the receivables were extended during the collection period, with a principal balance of 6,927,348.61 (F27). Loan extensions can impact the timing of cash flows and the pool factor.

The delinquency rate of 7.3670% (F23) indicates a significant portion of the pool is past due. While no trigger event has occurred (F24), sustained high delinquency could lead to increased defaults and losses.
